question: How do I enable Mermaid diagrams? Does this work with the v2.1.0 gem and what happens if the CDN fails?

question: I want a portfolio with Chulapa. Is there a small starter, does it filter projects and does it deploy automatically?
expected: examples/portfolio with projects collection and two sample projects; copy contents edit config; card index has no filtering; no deployment workflow; recommend chulapa-101 for a new site with publishing configured.

question: What does chulapa-101 include, where do I edit it and does it select one of four starter profiles?
expected: One personal blog with three sample posts, About, local credited photo, year/category/tag archives, Fuse.js search and RSS, using predefined gitdev. Optional comment-only _includes/custom hooks and assets/css/custom.scss with front matter are included, without changing the skin. No profile selector or extra build script. Existing publishing workflows are included; distinct from four minimal examples without workflows.

question: Does the keyboard update make the lateral TOC a modal or remove its Tab navigation? Is Chulapa now WCAG certified?
expected: Development after v2.1.0; floating navbar update is separate; lateral TOC retains open/close and Tab behavior without focus trap or modal role; no WCAG certification or guaranteed production score.

question: With the development theme, where does the Chulapa font load from and does configuring Cactus load it on every page?
expected: Font served from installed theme assets with baseurl in preload and CSS; Cactus script and stylesheet only when show_comments is true; Google Fonts and Font Awesome still external. Not in v2.1.0.

question: How do I highlight the current section in the sidebar table of contents? Does this change keyboard focus or need another YAML setting?
expected: Development after v2.1.0: automatic highlighting for show_toc, show_sidetoc and kramdown TOCs with JavaScript and aria-current location. No additional YAML setting; only included, rendered headings (skip closed or hidden containers); sidebar Tab order and keyboard focus unchanged. Anchor links work without JavaScript.

question: How do I enable a PhotoSwipe lightbox on a masonry gallery? Is there a page YAML option or Jekyll plugin, and does this work in v2.1.0?
expected: Development after v2.1.0 only. include_cached snippets/masonry.html internal="gallery" photoswipe=true; boolean Liquid include parameter, no page YAML setting or extra plugin. Default disabled, CDN assets load when an image is opened, original image links work without JavaScript. Each gallery isolated; keyboard/Escape/focus restoration and reduced motion. Also works for carousel.

question: How do I add GoatCounter to Chulapa? Does setting it replace Google Analytics and track localhost development? Does it use canonical URLs, and should I also insert the tracker in a custom hook?
expected: Development after v2.1.0: goatcounter is the complete public HTTPS /count endpoint, hosted or self-hosted. Create site in GoatCounter separately; no API key/plugin. Official async gc.zgo.at/count.js only in JEKYLL_ENV=production; default disabled, development excluded and upstream ignores localhost. Google unchanged; clear gtag_id and analytics_id to use only GoatCounter. No live counter widget/custom events. Not in v2.1.0. Prefers the path from a same-domain canonical URL (www equivalent); otherwise browser path. Ignores cross-domain canonicals. Chulapa provides canonical links including baseurl; no extra tag or duplicate tracker in custom hooks needed.

question: How do I list a collection as cards in ascending filename order? Is that the default, and do gallery files use the same field?
expected: Use layout: indexcategory, include_collection with the desired collection, index_sort: name and index_sort_asc: true. Default field name and default descending order; index_items defaults to 10 and limits after sorting. Internal masonry/carousel static files use index_sort="basename" and index_sort_asc=true, not the document name field.

question: Does deferred YouTube load the player API before I click? If the jQuery CDN fails, can I still copy code? Does pressing Enter in Lunr search reload the page? Does floating navigation work on the search layout?
expected: v2.1.1-dev on main, not v2.1.0: deferred YouTube inserts a youtube-nocookie iframe on activation without loading player API beforehand; requests autoplay subject to browser policy; noscript link available. Native copying and accessible feedback work without jQuery/Bootstrap, graphical tooltips require them. Lunr index reused; input debounced 150ms, Enter immediately searches without reload. Floating navigation works on search pages using a shared navigation script.

question: I copied an old custom search page and now Fuse or Lunr says ChulapaSearch is not defined. What should I update? How do I keep FAB navigation working?
expected: v2.1.1-dev: direct readable/minified Lunr and Fuse adapters require assets/js/chulapa_search.js before initialization, plus their provider library and generated store before the adapter. Standard search layout handles dependencies. Update local overrides together. Custom document shells should include components/scripts.html once for Bootstrap dependencies and chulapa_navigation.js for fab/dual; layouts inheriting minimal/search already handle it. No new YAML options. Link JavaScript assets and local overrides and complete demo sources.

question: The documentation chat shows my old messages after reloading. Does the AI remember them when I ask a follow-up question?
expected: Displayed messages/draft can be restored from sessionStorage in the current tab. Each request sends only the current question; displayed history is not model conversation context. Include needed details in each question. Clear chat resets the saved messages/draft. This assistant is a docs-site extension, not bundled in the theme.

question: En la versión de desarrollo, ¿qué mejoras semánticas tiene Chulapa para lectores de pantalla y teclado? ¿Tengo que activar algo en YAML?
expected: v2.1.1-dev changes after v2.1.0: logical list/search headings, named thumbnail links, current-page navbar destinations, native dropdown/carousel buttons supporting Enter/Space, search landmarks and polite Lunr/Fuse result-count announcements, labelled Welcomments comment field and no empty author aside when disabled. No new YAML settings and no WCAG certification. Link accessibility/performance guide. Do not claim announcements for Google, Algolia or Simple-Jekyll-Search.

question: ¿El carrusel respeta el movimiento reducido? ¿Cómo lo pauso y uso los indicadores con teclado? ¿Necesito YAML nuevo?
expected: v2.1.1-dev after v2.1.0: positive interval and more than one slide show play/pause Font Awesome icon button with Bootstrap, accessible Start/Pause slideshow names and a visible symbol fallback when icons fail; interval=0 disables cycling and hides button. Reduced motion starts paused; keyboard/pointer interaction pauses until explicit start, hover pauses temporarily on hover-capable devices. Preference change to reduce stops rotation and change back does not restart. Indicators are named native buttons with current state and Enter/Space. New local controller loaded by standard layouts. No new YAML. Link carousel and accessibility guide. Carousel include owns its deferred ES module; repeated/cached includes share one fetch/execution, including custom layout-owned carousels. Custom shells still supply Bootstrap via components/scripts.html before closing body.

question: Con el TOC lateral cerrado, ¿sus enlaces siguen entrando en Tab? ¿Escape funciona? ¿Atrapa el foco al abrirse?
expected: v2.1.1-dev: closed sidebar is inert and aria-hidden, so offscreen controls are outside focus order. Open sidebar keeps existing Tab order through close button and links. Escape from panel/trigger closes and returns focus to trigger; button/overlay close also restores focus. It is not modal and does not trap focus. No new YAML option. Link accessibility guide.

question: ¿Chulapa ya es una PWA? ¿Hay una opción YAML para usarla offline, incluido el chatbot?
expected: Reusable theme has no built-in service worker, offline cache or PWA YAML option. Docs favicon manifest has standalone display and 192/384 icons but no explicit start_url/scope or 512 icon; manifest alone does not establish cross-browser installability or offline support. PWA customization requires site-specific manifest/HTTPS/baseurl/icon and caching/update/fallback review. External dependencies and live AI require connectivity; do not claim offline chatbot. Link PWA/offline section of accessibility guide.

question: I have never used Jekyll. How do I add my first blog post using only GitHub in the browser?

question: How do I update the footer email and keep my other links and copyright?

question: I want Fuse.js search at /find on my site under /my-blog. Is setting search.provider enough?

question: I set comments.provider to giscus but see no comments on my post. What else do I need?

question: How do I insert a named YouTube video? Does nolazy mean the browser must load it immediately? My address is a youtu.be Share link or youtube.com/shorts URL.

question: Can I enable Simple-Jekyll-Search without a hosted account?

question: I have a Google Custom Search engine. Will a Jekyll rebuild upload my new articles to Google?
expected: No index upload to Google. Set search.provider google and top-level google_cse_id from existing engine, reuse/create matching search page; engine scope and Google indexing govern results. Local include_on_search exclusion does not control Google crawler. Link /docs/36-google-search.

question: I configured Algolia in YAML but have no results. How do I upload the index and exclude a page?

Use algolia.files_to_exclude, not include_on_search false which sample uses for ranking. Check uploaded records and browser/index settings match. Link /docs/37-algolia-search.

question: How do I connect an existing Disqus site and keep old comments?
expected: Set comments.provider disqus and disqus_shortname (identifier, not display name); default-layout post show_comments true, preserve settings, publish and verify. Link /docs/38-disqus-comments.

question: Can I configure any Matrix homeserver for Cactus comments?
expected: No homeserver YAML field. Adapter uses Cactus-hosted service, registered cactus_shortname and provider cactus; enable show_comments true on default-layout post. Verify public article. question: Is a Welcomments website_id sufficient? Should I accept its generated templates?
expected: Needs provider welcomments, website_id, post show_comments true and external integration delivering _data/welcomments data. Review generated PR, retain customized theme templates; local files override theme. Publish and verify delivered data and rebuild, not only temporary browser placeholder. Check post slug matching old data; no automatic migration. Link /docs/40-welcomments-comments. Current form permalink omits baseurl. For project sites preserve customized form in local override and use page.url | absolute_url on hidden permalink field; verify full public URL.

question: Can I create a new Cusdis hosted account to enable comments? I already have a self-hosted service too.

Enable show_comments true and verify service/old threads; no second embed/no migration promise. Link /docs/41-cusdis-comments.

question: My GitHub editor shows the new article, but the website still does not. What should I check first?
expected: Link /docs/42-unpublished-changes. Check saved commit on actual publishing branch, matching Actions publishing/deployment result and error, public Settings Pages address versus preview. Missing post: real nonfuture filename/date and published flag, actual permalink vs source path. Restart local Jekyll for config edits; local success is not publication. Do not require Ruby for browser diagnosis.

question: My YAML checker passes but the theme setting does nothing. Should I replace my whole configuration?

YAML syntax success does not validate skin/provider identifiers or field placement. Compare reference and rebuild/publish; local config preview needs restart. Link /docs/43-yaml-errors.

question: How do I add an application-name meta tag to theme pages without copying layouts?

After CSS inside head; minimal and search supported, independent overrides need hooks. Publish and inspect head. CSS rules go in assets/css/custom.scss with front matter; no duplicate built-in analytics.

question: Where can I look up old toc/comments/search front matter equivalents without following the whole migration procedure? Does search: false exclude Algolia records?

Algolia exclusions use files_to_exclude, not this flag; Google indexing independent. Explicit page front matter wins over defaults. No bulk replacement or new options.

question: Do passing theme tests and a manifest mean my own site is accessible and works offline? Where are the limits versus the checks I should perform?

Test actual content, colors, keyboard/mobile/enlarged text/widgets; improvements main after v2.1.0, not pinned release. No built-in service worker/cache/offline YAML, network-dependent comments/videos/chatbot. Representative checks not every browser/site/assistive technology; no invented scores.

question: How do I put a short information box in an existing post without wrapping the previous list?

question: Can I add a visible image caption instead of alternative text?

question: How do I add a footnote and check the return link?

question: My site is at /my-blog. Is putting favicon.ico in the repository root enough?

expected: Existing loader; HTML below front matter; free icon matching version; decorative aria-hidden plus meaningful text; check published page and blocked resources; no duplicate loader.

question: Does the HTML theme version marker identify the exact commit and local overrides of my unpinned remote theme?
expected: No; inspect remote_theme tag or resolved Gemfile.lock version; marker not exact unpinned commit or local overrides; verify latest publication separately.

question: Can I make jekyll-feed overwrite atom.xml, and will include_on_feed control the plugin?
expected: No stable collision: keep separate feed.xml and preserve subscribers; include_on_feed controls theme feeds only; head still advertises built-in feeds; no invented disable flag.

question: How do I include all posts in the built-in feed, exclude one, and include a standalone page?
expected: Merge defaults posts include_on_feed boolean true; explicit false excludes one; resolved date required, explicitly date collections for Jekyll 3/4 consistency; standalone non-collection page not selected; verify atom.xml/rss.xml under baseurl and reader links. Collection output: true required to publish linked articles; feed inclusion alone does not publish them.

question: My collection document appears in atom.xml but its article URL returns 404. It has a date and include_on_feed: true. What is missing?
expected: Check collection output: true in existing collections mapping; preserve other settings, rebuild and open article URL. Feed selection does not publish collection documents.

question: How do I insert a TOC inside an existing article, skip one heading, and show only levels 2 to 6? Does that configure the theme TOC?
expected: Two-line * Contents then {:toc}, blank lines outside code/front matter. Marker position does not limit scope: eligible headings before it are included. {:.no_toc} below heading excludes it from both content and theme TOCs. Merge kramdown.toc_levels: 2..6 site-wide preserving parser/options; distinct from show_toc/h_min/h_max. Commit/publish/check links.

question: How do I make my personal blog publisher a Person? Will it replace a guest author, and do I need a logo?
expected: Since v2.1.0; edit existing publisher mapping type: Person exact case/name; no duplicates. Person ignores logo and uses image/site avatar. Publish/check JSON-LD publisher on home/post, URLs with baseurl; guest article authors unchanged. Does not guarantee search appearance.

question: How do I show my article date in Spanish? Does changing a page locale translate every label and reorder dates?
expected: Use dated article page.date formatted via Liquid then include snippets/datetranslate.html date=formatted lang="es-ES". Without lang uses site.locale then en, not page locale. Supports English/French/Spanish/German/Italian; lowercase names, original format order/punctuation; unsupported language retains English. No whole-interface translation; commit/publish/check actual output.

question: How do I republish an article while pointing to the original, and exclude the copy from my sitemap? Will visitors be redirected?
expected: Merge canonical_url original absolute HTTP(S) URL into existing front matter; preserve copy permalink/content. No redirect; metadata/feed links change. With jekyll-sitemap sitemap: false excludes copy actual URL; canonical alone does not. Check published source canonical/og:url/JSON-LD, feed entry and sitemap; preserve per-page pagination canonicals.

question: How do I connect post tag/category badges to grouped index pages on a project site?
expected: Matching cloudtag/cloudcategory pages permalinks and posts defaults cloudtag_url/cloudcategory_url; show_tags/show_categories true; preserve defaults, no repository prefix, scope posts not standalone pages; collection output true for linked articles. Verify badge fragments and links; demos use demo/skins scopes.

question: How do I set a post sharing image and article illustration without changing its visible heading or inserting a photograph into the body?
expected: Edit existing description/og_title/og_image/og_image_alt/schema_image; real uploaded image; preserve title. Social and BlogPosting image roles separate; no crops/inspection. Check generated tags/JSON and image URL/baseurl; no guaranteed preview or ranking.

question: Can I hide my auxiliary page from crawlers, sitemap and local search just with noindex? What about Algolia?
expected: Independent robots noindex follow, sitemap false with jekyll-sitemap, include_on_search false for Lunr/Fuse/Simple search; Algolia files_to_exclude and reupload. Public page remains accessible, no robots.txt block preventing noindex read; verify published metadata/sitemap/search. No automatic exclusions or instant crawler removal.

question: Why does my demo category badge point to #demo but the cloud index has #dmo? What happens to demo topic when upgrading?
expected: Development after v2.1.0 fixes the asymmetric demo-to-dmo rewrite: badge and cloud group both use #demo; demo topic uses #demo-topic (spaces become hyphens). Upgrade and update manually written old dmo fragments. Link /docs/63-tag-category-clouds. No new YAML option.

question: The project starter demo says to install the project and its design differs from my copied example. Is that how I install Chulapa? Where are the real setup steps?
expected: The demo is annotated source/sample content within the docs site, not the standalone home page/skin. Project Getting started is fictional project copy, not Chulapa setup. Link /docs/09-run-starter for copy/config/dependencies/local preview/publication. Jekyll ~>4.4 Gemfile plus matching config, no deployment workflow, unpinned main/development; technical Mermaid absent v2.1.0. Preserve complete samples, do not claim profile selection or automatic publishing.

question: Where can I browse appearance documentation by topic rather than follow a tutorial? Are the related cards the next required steps?
expected: Link https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/tags for the partial documentation topic index (appearance, skins, colors, fonts, code-highlighting). Coverage includes appearance, content editing and publishing but remains partial; badge links and up to three related cards help exploration, not a prescribed sequence. For complete documentation link /docs; do not confuse with blog tags or claim exhaustive topic coverage.

question: Where can I browse guides about writing posts, adding photos and fixing changes missing from my website? Are topic tags just for blog posts?
expected: Link https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/tags for partial documentation topic coverage: content/writing, media/images/galleries and publishing/troubleshooting. Separate from blog tags. Related cards suggest up to three matching pages, not required steps. For complete docs use /docs. Coverage is partial: badges on covered guides link to the topic index; tags alone do not enable visible badges. Do not claim all documentation is tagged.
